lines.zh: 我浮着飘过去，下巴一直开合。
lines.en: I drift across with my jaw working.
I've no legs; I only drift.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的发梢飘过去。
lines.en: I drift past the tips of your hair.

lines.zh: 我的骨头上还挂着一点东西。
lines.en: Something still clings to my bones.
I count three laps around the pillar.
I drift toward the warmth.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝里是空的，可我看得见。
lines.en: My sockets are empty, and I can see.

lines.zh: 我慢慢升到和门一样高。
lines.en: I rise to door height.
I float in through the window.
I sway back and forth.

lines.zh: 我飘着在你身侧转了半圈。
lines.en: I drift half a circle at your side.
I rise a little higher.
I hang in place without a sound.
My teeth don't close.
There's a cold gleam inside me.
I listen to what moves around me.
I stopped using breath long ago.
I open my jaw and close it.
The quiet here rings hollow.

lines.zh: 我在等一个背对着我的。
lines.en: I'm waiting for someone facing away.

lines.zh: 我的头颅一点一点拧向你。
lines.en: I turn my skull toward you, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 黑暗里我的骨头是白的。
lines.en: My bones are white in the dark.

lines.zh: 你看见我了，骨头都白了。
lines.en: You've seen me; my bones show white.
I'm close, right before you.
My jaw moves once.

lines.zh: 你不该在这个时辰走路。
lines.en: You shouldn't be walking at this hour.
I rise a little.
I can hear you gasping.
I drift to shoulder height.
My sockets are deeper than the night.
Run, and I'll follow.
I drift half a foot nearer.
A crack opens in my bone.
I'm knocked aside and drift back.
My jaw won't close.
My sockets darken.
I hang a little lower.

lines.zh: 我在半空打了个旋才停住。
lines.en: I spin in the air before I steady.
A shard of bone falls.
I make no sound; I only drift.
I rise slowly again.
I head your way again.
No stomach left; I cannot swallow that.

lines.zh: 它从我肋骨间掉了出去。
lines.en: It falls straight through my ribs.

lines.zh: 那东西连我的骨头都碰不到。
lines.en: That thing cannot even touch my bones.
I don't eat any of this.
You needn't hold it up.
You're the only thing I want.
I knock it aside.

lines.zh: 我没有鼻子，只有你的热气。
lines.en: No nose, only the heat of you.
It falls to the ground; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 放下它，我要的还在站着。
lines.en: Set it down; what I want is still standing.
You hit me and my bones rattle.
I drift back a stretch.
I drift back in again.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的下巴磕上了。
lines.en: That clicks my jaw shut.

lines.zh: 骨头碰骨头，只有一点响。
lines.en: Bone meets bone with the smallest knock.
I drift a little aside.

lines.zh: 我的骨头没有肉可以挡。
lines.en: My bones have no flesh to take the blow.

lines.zh: 我从你手臂下面穿过去。
lines.en: I pass under your arm.
I stir the dust up.
I stop before you again.
Two skulls face each other in the air.

lines.zh: 她的骨头上没有那些东西。
lines.en: Her bones are clean of that.
We rise and fall together.
Our jaws open and close as one.
Her sockets are deeper than mine.
She circles me once.
Not even our bones knock.
She drifts off toward the wall.
There's room for both of us here.
At night we patrol together.
I bite it, and my teeth don't meet.
It falls through my jaw.
I butt it once.

lines.zh: 我的骨头碰在它上面，响。
lines.en: My bone knocks it and rings.
I carry it on my skull.
This isn't mine to carry.
I push it back toward you.
It passes through me.
I have no hands to hold it.
It falls and rolls away.
You've finally looked back.
I open my jaw as wide as it goes.
I speed up toward you.

lines.zh: 四下无人，只剩你的热气。
lines.en: Nobody else here, only your warmth.
I begin to rise.
I've chosen my angle of impact.

lines.zh: 你肩一动，我先走了半尺。
lines.en: Your shoulder shifts and I have moved a foot.
The gleam in my bones brightens.
I fly just under the ceiling.

lines.zh: 我从檐上垂下来接近你。
lines.en: I lower myself from the eaves toward you.
That stretch of your neck has no armor.
I make no cry; I don't need to.
I rush in at an angle.
I intend to hit this time.
Raising your arms is already too late.
The light in my sockets has picked you.
I've timed this impact.
I keep drifting after you.
You run a little faster than I drift.
I circle over and get ahead.
I slide along the beam.
You turn; I take the short way.
I'm close to the back of your neck.
You hear bone clicking.
I circle outside the window.

lines.zh: 你把门关上，我从缝里进来。
lines.en: You shut the door; I come through the gap.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶的影子里停住。
lines.en: I halt inside the shadow over your head.

lines.zh: 你走乱的步子，我听得很清。
lines.en: I hear every stumble in your step.
I rise a little to build the charge.

lines.zh: 我把头骨压到你的高度。
lines.en: I sink my skull down to your level.
You don't look up — perfect.
I quicken toward you.
This ram will crack your collarbone first.
Only now do you turn around.
I'm an arm's length in front of you.
My skull dips and I lunge.

lines.zh: 你听见咬合声的时候已经晚了。
lines.en: By the time you hear my jaw, it is too late.
My brow hits your chest and bone rings.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，牙撞在一起。
lines.en: I bite and my teeth clash.
It knocks you back.
I butt the side of your head.
You hit bone, and it's hard.
I pull back and charge again.
My jaw clicks shut.

lines.zh: 膝盖一磕，你就矮了半截。
lines.en: Your knee buckles and you drop halfway.
I pull back an inch and ram again.
Bone on stone, and it rings.
You're already against the wall.
I ram, again and again.
You can't raise your arms.

lines.zh: 我悬在你上方，慢慢低下去。
lines.en: I hang above you, sinking slowly.
This one puts you down.
I turn to find the next one.

lines.zh: 半空里出现一个白色的头骨。
lines.en: A white skull appears in the air.
My jaw moves first.

lines.zh: 空洞的眼窝先对准了光。
lines.en: My empty sockets find the light first.
The air here is warm.

lines.zh: 我没有身体，只有这个头。
lines.en: I've no body, only this head.
I drift over to the doorway.
Cold light shows between my bones.
I drift forward a stretch.
I hear someone in the house.
I stop outside the window.
I wait for you to blow the lamp out.
I've learned the paths here.
I drift up along the wall.
Someone walks below.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的骨头，我飘开了。
lines.en: Fire catches my bone and I drift off.
I hit the ground and my bones scatter.

lines.zh: 洞里灌满水，我慢慢往下沉。
lines.en: Water fills my hollow skull and I sink.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的骨头震散了。
lines.en: The blast shakes my bones apart.

lines.zh: 一根箭穿过了我的眼窝。
lines.en: An arrow goes through my eye socket.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的骨头僵住。
lines.en: The light freezes my bones.

lines.zh: 我没有身体，可我也会耗空。
lines.en: I've no body, and I can still run empty.

lines.zh: 雷打在骨上，我整个亮了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the bone and I light up.

lines.zh: 四周什么都没有，我一直飘。
lines.en: Nothing anywhere; I drift on.
